text: dsh-plugin-leaderboard 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的社区插件排行榜。它把排行榜放进侧栏页脚，并同时提供 agent 工具、/leaderboard 命令和 HTTP 数据接口。用户可以浏览按热度、创建时间和近期增长排序的插件，查看仓库信息、复制安装命令或解读提示，也能查看下载、解读和推荐榜。它从 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题读取目录，并优先尝试托管目录 API。适合想发现或比较 DSH 社区插件的用户；GitHub token 可选，没有额外 token 也能使用。

dsh-plugin-leaderboard adds a community plugin directory to the DSH web sidebar, with an agent tool and /leaderboard command. Browse hot, newest, and fast-growing plugins, inspect repositories, and copy install or explanation prompts. It reads GitHub and a hosted API; a GitHub token is optional.
想在 DSH 网页侧栏里找社区插件。
有没有按热度整理的 DSH 插件清单？
我想看看最近新发布了哪些 DSH 插件。
帮我比较哪些插件最近增长比较快。
想从会话里用命令调出插件排行榜。
让 agent 根据 GitHub 上的 DSH 插件目录回答热门插件问题。
Show me a ranked directory of community plugins for DSH.
I want to find recently created DSH plugins in the web interface.
dsh-plugin-leaderboard 的功能「网页侧栏排行榜」：插件在 Web UI 侧栏页脚注册排行榜面板，展示多个榜单标签页及插件条目。用户打开面板即可浏览，无需输入命令。
dsh-plugin-leaderboard 的功能「多种排序榜」：目录按星标和 fork、创建时间或近期增长计算热门、最新和最火榜单；另提供下载、解读和推荐榜入口。工具与面板可选择对应榜单。
dsh-plugin-leaderboard 的功能「agent 排行榜工具」：注册 list_dsh_plugin_leaderboard 工具，接受 board 与 refresh 参数并返回所选榜单数据和 Markdown 内容。
dsh-plugin-leaderboard 的功能「会话斜杠命令」：注册 /leaderboard 命令，在会话中读取排行榜快照并按输入的 hot、new 或 fire 选项格式化结果。
dsh-plugin-leaderboard 会从 GitHub API 获取公开仓库目录；可选 GitHub token 用于 API 请求，托管目录 API 也会接收面板中的仓库点击统计。

dsh-plugin-leaderboard README · dsh-plugin-leaderboard：[English](#install) | [中文](README.zh.md)

Community plugin leaderboard for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It reads the public GitHub topic [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) and shows three boards **inside the Web UI**:

dsh-plugin-leaderboard README · dsh-plugin-leaderboard：| Board | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **最热 / Hottest** | Most GitHub stars |
| **最新 / Newest** | Most recently created |
| **最火 Top 10 / On fire** | Top 10 by star density with a recency boost |
| **推荐 / Picks** | Curated list stored in MySQL |

dsh-plugin-leaderboard README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shaoxia20240902/dsh-plugin-leaderboard
```

Or from a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-plugin-leaderboard
```

Restart `dsh web`. The sidebar foot shows **插件榜**. You can also type `/leaderboard` in a session, or ask the agent to show the hottest / newest / on-fire plugins.

dsh-plugin-leaderboard README · What you get：- **Sidebar panel** — three tabs, star/fork counts, copy-install, **copy an interpret prompt**, open the repo.
- **Interpret prompt** — paste it into the Harness composer. The agent clones the repo and explains it in plain language: what it is, what pain it removes, what you see after install, how to start, who should skip it.
- **Slash command** `/leaderboard [hot|new|fire]`.
- **Tool** `list_dsh_plugin_leaderboard` so the agent can answer ranking questions.
- **HTTP** `GET /dsh-plugin-leaderboard` on the host (used by the panel).

dsh-plugin-leaderboard README · What you get：These repositories are third-party code. Review the source and pin a commit (`github:owner/repo#<sha>`) before you install one.

Boards load first from the hosted API `http://101.34.27.122:3091` (MySQL), then fall back to GitHub. The recommend list lives only in that database.
dsh-plugin-leaderboard README · When GitHub is blocked：Default `access: auto`: try `api.github.com` first, then public HTTPS proxies (for example `ghfast.top`).

dsh-plugin-leaderboard README · When GitHub is blocked：- **Board data** — the host retries through a proxy so the sidebar still fills in.
- **Open repository** — official `https://github.com/owner/repo`. Host-swap sites such as kkgithub.com 404 on most repos, so they are not used.
- **Details** — a page on the hosted API (`/r/owner/repo`) with description plus a working clone-via-proxy command.
- **Copy install / Explain** — include a “clone via proxy, then `dsh plugin add <dir>`” command.

dsh-plugin-leaderboard README · When GitHub is blocked：**A GitHub token is sent only to the official API, never through a public proxy.** Public mirrors are third-party and can vanish; override them when you have a stable one:

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-leaderboard
  config:
    access: auto
    githubApiBase: https://your-proxy.example/https://api.github.com

dsh-plugin-leaderboard README · Ranking：- **Hottest** — `ln(1+stars) + 0.55 ln(1+forks) + 0.6×freshness + 0.4×DSH relevance − stale penalty`.
- **Newest** — recency of creation raised to 1.8, times a traction term so empty shells lose to same-week repos that already have stars.
- **On fire** — HN-style gravity `(stars + 0.65 forks) / (age+2)^1.55`, times recent motion. Top 10.
- **Picks** — curated in MySQL.

dsh-plugin-leaderboard README · Ranking：The catalog merges a few GitHub search pages (stars + recently updated), then drops `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`, forks, and archived repos. The hosted API stores that catalog in MySQL, refreshes it every 30 minutes, and serves the sidebar from the database. Opening the panel never waits on GitHub. A manual refresh asks the origin to sync under `GET_LOCK`; concurrent clicks join or keep the last snapshot. The host process also keeps a short in-memory copy (stale-while-revalidate).

dsh-plugin-leaderboard README · Configuration：Optional `cordis.yml` / profile patch on the `dsh-plugin-leaderboard` row:

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-leaderboard
  config:
    githubToken: # or set GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN
    topic: dsh-plugin

Unauthenticated GitHub search is enough for a personal install. A token raises the rate limit if you refresh often.

dsh-plugin-leaderboard README · Develop：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
pnpm build
```

`lib/` is the runtime. The client bundle is `lib/client.js` and loads through the Web GUI module table.
